description: The University of Salzburg publishes 325 complete responses from professionals working with cycling data in 32 countries. The survey records their current data use, unmet needs and views on future applications in cycling policy and planning. Germany, Austria and Italy account for 241 responses, so the sample is geographically uneven. Zenodo provides the CSV dataset with CC BY 4.0 for free reuse. The metadata describes a completed survey, not a continuing observation service; exact collection dates were not established in this review. These responses can inform assumptions about information availability and organisational behaviour in cycling-policy simulations. They do not measure cyclist flows or travel demand. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
name: Bicycle Mobility Data: Current Use and Future Potential. An International Survey of Domain Professionals
